description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkConfigParsing module, verifying the correct behavior of provider configuration parsing, fallback mechanisms, and data bridging functionality in Swift.

methods.name: prefersCanonicalResolvedTalkProviderPayload
methods.description: Tests that the provider configuration is correctly selected when a resolved payload is provided.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedTalkProviderPayloadWithoutResolved
methods.description: Verifies rejection of normalized payloads lacking a resolved provider.

methods.name: fallsBackToLegacyTalkFieldsWhenNormalizedPayloadMissing
methods.description: Ensures fallback to legacy fields when normalized payloads are absent.

methods.name: canDisableLegacyFallback
methods.description: Tests disabling fallback to legacy fields via flag.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedPayloadWhenProviderMissingFromProviders
methods.description: Checks rejection when provider info is missing from the providers dictionary.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedPayloadWhenMultipleProvidersAndNoProvider
methods.description: Ensures rejection when multiple providers exist but no specific provider is selected.

methods.name: bridgesFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Tests conversion of Foundation-style dictionaries to internal representations.

methods.name: resolvesPositiveIntegerTimeout
methods.description: Verifies correct resolution of timeout values, including fallback behavior.
